name: Star Wars
hook: A 1977 blockbuster, a John Williams score and a galaxy of catchphrases Jeopardy returns to constantly.

facts.label: George Lucas
facts.statement: George Lucas's Star Wars opened in 1977; Akira Kurosawa's The Hidden Fortress and Yojimbo helped inspire it.

facts.label: John Williams
facts.statement: John Williams composed the Star Wars theme; Meco's disco version hit No. 1 while Williams's own single reached No. 10.

facts.label: Carrie Fisher
facts.statement: Carrie Fisher played Princess Leia and later wrote Postcards from the Edge about her drug dependency.

facts.label: James Earl Jones
facts.statement: James Earl Jones voiced Darth Vader for $7,000, redubbing David Prowse's lines.

facts.label: the original trilogy
facts.statement: The original trilogy runs A New Hope, The Empire Strikes Back, Return of the Jedi; "Episode IV: A New Hope" was added later.

facts.label: C-3PO
facts.statement: Anthony Daniels is the only actor to appear in every Star Wars film, as C-3PO.

facts.label: Luke Skywalker
facts.statement: Luke Skywalker was nearly named "Starkiller"; Episode IX, The Rise of Skywalker, closed the saga in 2019.
